Implemented three-layer fix: (1) CameraDaemon.main() now has a secondary port-availability check before trusting the lock file — connects to TCP:19876, HTTP:8080, and IPC:19877; if any port accepts a connection, exits immediately. This catches cases where FileChannel.tryLock() on tmpfs spuriously allows duplicate lock acquisition. (2) DaemonStartupManager health check now uses the full launch flow (isDaemonRunning + isCameraDaemonResponsive) for camera daemon instead of just ps-based process check, preventing false-positive relaunches from ADB blips. (3) start_cam_daemon.sh watchdog script now checks /proc/<lock-pid> before spawning app_process — if a live PID holds the lock, the watchdog exits.

Increased MAX_PACKET_SIZE from 256KB to 768KB in H264CircularBuffer.java:31. Root cause: camera configured at BITRATE=4Mbps, KEYFRAME_INTERVAL=2s, 5120x960@25fps produces I-frames up to 527KB which exceeded 256KB limit. Buffer dropped all I-frames as oversized, resulting in 0 keyframes. New 768KB threshold handles STANDARD-H.264 comfortably through PREMIUM typical I-frames. Pool ceiling 200 x 768KB = 150MB peak.
